SpaceFields to establish rocket propellant facility in Andhra Pradesh

SpaceFields, a company backed by venture capital investors, is set to establish a rocket propellant processing facility in Andhra Pradesh's Anantapur district. The state government will allocate approximately 120.76 acres of land for the project. This development is part of a larger rare-earth scheme estimated to be worth ₹20,000 crore.
